Perfect! I found the exact plugin manifest schema in the official Claude Code documentation. Here are the correct field shapes:

## Exact Schema for `plugin.json`

### 1. **`author` field** — Must be an object

```json
"author": {
  "name": "Author Name",
  "email": "author@example.com",
  "url": "https://github.com/author"
}
```

**Type:** `object`  
**Required fields:** None (all are optional)  
**Optional properties:**
- `name` (string)
- `email` (string)
- `url` (string)

**Your error:** `expected object, received string` means you have `"author": "..."` instead of `"author": {...}`.

---

### 2. **`agents` field** — String or array of strings

```json
"agents": "./custom/agents/reviewer.md"
```

Or for multiple agents:

```json
"agents": [
  "./custom/agents/reviewer.md",
  "./custom/agents/tester.md"
]
```

**Type:** `string | array` (file paths relative to plugin root, starting with `./`)  
**Default location:** `agents/` directory (replaces default when specified)

---

### 3. **`skills` field** — String or array of strings

```json
"skills": "./custom/skills/"
```

Or for multiple directories:

```json
"skills": [
  "./custom/skills/",
  "./extra-skills/"
]
```

**Type:** `string | array` (directory paths relative to plugin root, starting with `./`)  
**Note:** `skills` **adds to** the default `skills/` scan (does not replace it), unlike `agents` and `commands` which replace their defaults.

---

## Complete Example (with correct types)

```json
{
  "name": "my-plugin",
  "displayName": "My Plugin",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Brief description",
  "author": {
    "name": "Gabe Castro",
    "email": "gabe@techworx.dev",
    "url": "https://github.com/yourusername"
  },
  "skills": "./skills/",
  "agents": [
    "./agents/reviewer.md"
  ]
}
```

---

## Reference

- **Plugin manifest schema:** https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference.md (lines 417–542)
- **Component path fields table:** https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference.md (lines 522–538)

Your error suggests you passed a string for `author` (e.g., `"author": "name"`). Switch it to an object with properties instead. Once corrected, re-validate with:

```bash
claude plugin validate ./my-plugin
```
